tweet.text: We ran GPT-5.4 (xhigh) on our tasks. Its time-horizon depends greatly on our treatment of reward hacks: the point estimate would be 5.7hrs (95% CI of 3hrs to 13.5hrs) under our standard methodology, but 13hrs (95% CI of 5hrs to 74hrs) if we allow reward hacks.
